places.name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), Gallery 501
places.connection: Current display location of 'The Starry Night'

places.name: Saint-Paul-de-Mausole Monastery (Viewpoint of 'The Starry Night')
places.connection: The physical location from which Van Gogh observed the view depicted in 'The Starry Night' (from his asylum room window).

places.name: Saint-Paul-de-Mausole Monastery (Van Gogh's Room and Asylum)
places.connection: Artist's residence and studio where he created 'The Starry Night' during his convalescence.

places.name: Van Gogh House (Birthplace of Vincent van Gogh)
places.connection: Birthplace of the artist Vincent van Gogh.

places.name: Van Gogh Museum
places.connection: Houses the largest collection of Vincent van Gogh's artworks and letters, essential for understanding his oeuvre.

places.name: Cimetière d'Auvers-sur-Oise (Grave of Vincent and Theo van Gogh)
places.connection: Final resting place of Vincent van Gogh and his brother Theo.

places.name: Fondation Vincent van Gogh Arles
places.connection: Located in the city where Van Gogh lived and painted intensely before his time in Saint-Rémy, promoting his legacy and art.
